text.aria-label: Title text 'Training on ERA5 lowers wind error much more on the largest outputs than on average; for solar the tail gain is uncertain'

g.text: Training on ERA5 lowers wind error much more on the largest outputs than on average; for solar the tail gain is uncertain

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in mean absolute error from the ENS-trained model with the same columns, points of capacity (more negative is better), for the cases in the top decile of observed power and for all cases, by how many days ahead the forecast is. Top decile: cases where observed power exceeds the generator's 90th percentile of power in 2019-09 to 2025-06. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. Solid line at zero: same as the ENS-trained model. Orange: top decile. Blue: all cases (planned contrast P1). ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns. 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.'
text.tspan: Change in mean absolute error from the ENS-trained model with the same columns, points of capacity (more negative is better), for the cases in the top decile of observed power and for all cases, by how many days ahead the forecast is.

Top decile: cases where observed power exceeds the generator's 90th percentile of power in 2019-09 to 2025-06. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval. Solid line at zero: same as the ENS-trained model. Orange: top decile. Blue: all cases (planned contrast P1).

ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every model on these charts is an XGBoost model given the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns.
6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.
